name: SpatialMD
tagline: AR and 3D surgical guidance that brings remote expert help to rural hospitals.

awards: Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs

problem: Rural hospitals lack specialist surgeons for complex procedures.
solution: Combines 3D reconstruction, hand and object tracking and vision-language models with live video for remote guidance.
demo_moment: Team-described: a remote expert annotates a 3D view during a procedure.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs” among 195 submissions.
Draws analogies from remote software collaboration.
